sn14.32:1.2: paṭhavīdhātuyāhaṃ bhikkhave, assādapariyesanaṃ acariṃ. yo paṭhavīdhātuyā assādo, tadajjhagamaṃ. yāvatā paṭhavīdhātuyā assādo, paññāya me so sudiṭṭho.
sn14.32:1.3: paṭhavīdhātuyāhaṃ bhikkhave, ādīnavapariyesanaṃ acariṃ. yo paṭhavīdhātuyā ādīnavo, tadajjhagamaṃ. yāvatā paṭhavīdhātuyā ādīnavo, paññāya me so sudiṭṭho.
sn14.32:1.4: paṭhavīdhātuyāhaṃ bhikkhave, nissaraṇapariyesanaṃ acariṃ. yaṃ paṭhavīdhātuyā nissaraṇaṃ, tadajjhagamaṃ. yāvatā paṭhavīdhātuyā nissaraṇaṃ, paññāya me taṃ sudiṭṭhaṃ.
sn14.32:2.3: vāyodhātuyāhaṃ bhikkhave, assādapariyesanaṃ acariṃ. yo vāyodhātuyā assādo, tadajjhagamaṃ. yāvatā vāyodhātuyā assādo, paññāya me so sudiṭṭho.
sn14.32:2.4: vāyodhātuyāhaṃ bhikkhave, ādīnavapariyesanaṃ acariṃ. yo vāyodhātuyā ādīnavo, tadajjhagamaṃ. yāvatā vāyodhātuyā ādīnavo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho.
sn14.32:2.5: vāyodhātuyāhaṃ bhikkhave, nissaraṇapariyesanaṃ acariṃ. yaṃ vāyodhātuyā nissaraṇaṃ. tadajjhagamaṃ. yāvatā vāyodhātuyā nissaraṇaṃ, paññāya me taṃ sudiṭṭhaṃ.
sn14.32:3.1: yāvakīvañcāhaṃ bhikkhave, imāsaṃ catunnaṃ dhātūnaṃ assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ nābbhaññāsiṃ, neva tāvāhaṃ bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake, sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadeva manussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.
sn14.32:4.1: yato ca khohaṃ bhikkhave, imāsaṃ catunnaṃ dhātūnaṃ assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, athāhaṃ bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake, sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti paccaññāsiṃ.
sn14.32:4.3: “akuppā me cetovimutti. ayamantimā jāti. natthidāni punabbhavo”ti.
